title: xs[i] = f(xs) stores into a stale element when f grows or shrinks xs
reproducer:
def bump(mut xs: List[Int]) -> Int:
    xs.append(7)
    return 5


def main():
    var xs: List[Int] = [1, 2]
    xs[0] = bump(xs)
    print(xs[0], len(xs))
compiler: accepts and prints `1 3`, as 1.2.0 did: it locates xs[0] before the call, the append reallocates, and the store of 5 is lost. Built with --sanitize address, AddressSanitizer reports heap-use-after-free

nightly.result: accepts and prints `1 3`; AddressSanitizer reports heap-use-after-free, as on 1.2.0
